title: Lab 02 Report: AI-Assisted Software Requirements Prioritization

sections.title: 1. Engineering Hypothesis Before AI
sections.placeholder: After running the vote-only baseline, identify one questionable release outcome and state your hypothesis about which additional evidence should influence prioritization.

sections.title: 2. Baseline Release Evidence
sections.placeholder: Document the selected baseline requirements, budget usage, visible product capabilities, and one limitation of vote-only prioritization.

sections.title: 3. NLP Investigation and Policy Design
sections.placeholder: Explain what the Naive Bayes model predicts, include evidence from at least three backlog items and one wording experiment, then justify your chosen AI/business/strategic/vote/accessibility/effort policy.

sections.title: 4. AI-Assisted Release and Verification
sections.placeholder: Document the AI-assisted ranking, selected release, visible product changes, verification results, and whether the release differs from the baseline.

sections.title: 5. Sensitivity and Critical Analysis
sections.placeholder: Report both wording-sensitivity and policy-sensitivity experiments. Discuss stability, bias, confidence, explainability, cost, accessibility, and how much decision authority the AI should have.

sections.title: 6. Release Recommendation and Conclusion
sections.placeholder: State whether you would ship the baseline or AI-assisted release. Defend the recommendation using model evidence, engineering constraints, product impact, and experiment results.
